title: Early Childhood Education Administration
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to know and understand the established as well as recent theories of child development.

Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to recognize and challenge issues of bias that children, individuals and families experience.

Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to analyze and think critically about the teacher’s comprehensive role in early learning and development settings.

Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to recognize and evaluate the interrelationships of the child, family, school and greater community.
Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to apply human development theory to observation and practice.
Upon successful completion of courses leading to the CDES Early Childhood Education Administration Certificate the student will be able to design quality early childhood programs and curriculum.

notes: CDES 205 F and CDES 230 F are printed in the required list but are not in the closed list; recorded as catalog additions.

Outcomes were read from the page's outcomes tab; the 'Outcome N:' labels were dropped, and each outcome's full sentence (including its 'Upon successful completion...' wording, which is part of each printed outcome) was kept.
The description says students must already meet the minimum requirements for the Teacher Permit on the Child Development Permit matrix; this prerequisite is not a course block.

The page mentions qualifying for the Title V Child Development Permit at the Site Supervisor level and acting in a leadership and administrative capacity; these were read as permit levels and roles rather than named careers, so careers is empty. A reviewer may want to check this reading.
Closed-list title for CDES 210 F ('Anti-Bias Perspective/Diversity Seminar') differs slightly from the catalog title ('Anti-Bias Perspective and Diversity Seminar').
